issues.where: crop A upper chromospheric haze around vertical plasma strands
issues.what: mild blocky smudging and mosquito noise appear in the dim reddish haze between thin spicule strands on later motion frames
issues.fix: slightly damp the highest-frequency temporal boil and sub-pixel spark flicker so later inter-frames retain enough bitrate for the low-contrast chromospheric haze

issues.where: crop E night-side terrain (1328,704), same region in image-13.png
issues.what: near-black slate terrain quantizes into an 8x8 chroma block grid with flat color patches and a faint vertical seam; not visible at the delivered exposure, clear once the shadow is lifted, and absent from the source and from the matching night crop in image-16.png
issues.fix: give the night side more chroma bits or a stronger deblock so crushed terrain does not lock to a block grid

issues.where: crop I, right-hand panel, dark sky beside the atmospheric limb
issues.what: The encoded blue-gray haze breaks into faint rectangular patches that are not present in the source. The limb itself stays smooth at full-frame scale.
issues.fix: Reduce contrast in the finest background texture around the limb so more of the fixed bitrate goes to the haze gradient.

issues.where: crops D and E, right-hand panel, sparse stars below the blue crescent and across the adjacent dark sky
issues.what: Several individually resolved dim stars fade or disappear in the encode, and a few remaining points smear into their surroundings. The brighter stars and ring structure hold up.
issues.fix: Give the dim stars that should survive slightly broader luminance cores without lifting the whole starfield.
